## 总体判断

The overview is present, but the data story needs sharper comparisons and fewer vague phrases.

## 最高优先级修改

Name each transport mode and give a clear overall trend before detail paragraphs.

## 完整改写稿

The chart compares bus, cycle, and car trips in a fictional city between 2000 and 2020.

Overall, bus travel remained the main mode, cycling increased, and car trips declined slightly.

Bus journeys stayed around a high share across the period. Cycling rose from a low base to a larger share by 2020, while car trips edged down.
